title: Website Management and Manual Testing QA
description:
**Job Summary**
As a Website Management and Quality Check Engineer (Manual) at Taxmann, you will play a crucial role in managing website and ensuring its quality and functionality. You will work closely with the development and content teams to manage content uploads, plan deployments, perform manual and regression testing, and provide valuable feedback to improve our website. The ideal candidate will have a strong analytical mindset, excellent communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-quality software.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Website Management: Manage day-to-day website operations and regularly check pages, navigation, links, downloads, and key user journeys to identify issues and ensure smooth functioning.
* Content Uploading: Upload, update, and manage approved content, documents, images, and other website materials through the content management system (CMS). Verify accuracy, formatting, links, and display before and after publishing.
* Manual Testing: Perform comprehensive manual testing of the website across browsers and devices to identify defects, inconsistencies, and usability issues.
* Test Planning: Collaborate with the development team to create detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on requirements and specifications for website updates and new features.
* Execution: Execute test cases to verify website functionality and usability, ensuring all requirements are met. Perform smoke testing after each deployment to verify key functionality on the live website.
* Defect Identification: Identify, document, and prioritize defects and user-reported issues, and work with the development team to facilitate their resolution and verify fixes.
* Regression Testing: Conduct regression testing to ensure that software changes, content updates, and deployments do not negatively impact existing functionality.
* Deployment Planning: Coordinate with the development and content teams to plan deployment schedules, confirm testing completion and approvals, maintain release checklists, and coordinate post-deployment checks and rollback readiness.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation, including test cases, test results, defect reports, content update records, and release notes.
* Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless communication and alignment on website updates, deployment priorities, and quality objectives.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively suggest process improvements to enhance website management, content uploading, and the quality assurance process.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in website management, content uploading, manual software testing, and quality assurance.
* Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC), testing methodologies, and deployment processes.
* Familiarity with content management systems (CMS), testing tools, and bug tracking systems (e.g., ALM, JIRA etc.).
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Attention to detail and a methodical approach to website management and testing.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

Skills:- Website administration, Manual testing and Software Testing (QA)
